verdict.rationale: Productboard lets PMs control what reaches delivery: only fully-validated features are sent to developers, and features are pushed into Jira or GitHub once ready for development. That implies a PM-controlled handoff, but nothing shows a formal scope-review or approval step. Missing for 10: an explicit approval/sign-off workflow or status gate, documentation of reviewing task scope before work starts, any way to block agent or dev work until approval, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
